name: Power Of The Tongue
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of the tongue, highlighting the need for careful speech that honors God and preserves life. The psalmist prays for the words of the mouth and meditations of the heart to be acceptable before the Lord, recognizing Him as strength and redeemer (Psalms 19:14). Wisdom is shown in restraining the lips to avoid sin and destruction (Proverbs 10:19; 13:3), while the tongue of the wise brings healing rather than harm (Proverbs 12:18). Believers are called to seek God's protection over their speech, asking Him to guard their mouths and lips (Psalms 141:3), trusting that the Lord answers and delivers in times of distress (Psalms 118:5).
